versions.content: XML Schema production rule: global xsd:element Applies to Class Precondition xml.globalElement=true Target pattern: <xsd:element name= "<%=typeXmlName%>" type= "<% typeXmlNsPrefix%>:<%=typeXmlName%>" /> Description: If the class is marked by the tagged value 'xml.globalElement=true' then a global xsd:element is created. The name of the xsd:element is defined by the XML-name of the class and the type is defined by the xsd:complexType which was defined by [TPS_XMLSPR_00003]. The namespace prefix is defined by the tagged value 'xml.nsPrefix'. UML example: See Figure 5.7. XML schema example: <xsd:element name= "AUTOSAR" type= "AR:AUTOSAR" /> 5 53 of 90  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 122: AUTOSAR_TPS_XMLSchemaProductionRules AUTOSAR XML Schema Production Rules AUTOSAR CP R19-11 4 XML instance example: <AUTOSAR> ... </AUTOSAR>
